environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS in namespace 'webapp-prod'. A Cilium-based NetworkPolicy object (apiVersion: cilium.io/v2, kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy) is applied with a spec.egress rule containing a toCIDRSet entry that explicitly denies 169.254.169.254/32 via a 'except' clause on the broader allow-all CIDR. The policy metadata annotation 'policy.cilium.io/enforcement: always' ensures the rule is active even during agent restarts. Additionally, the ALB target group has a custom attribute 'routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled=true' which strips non-standard headers but does NOT filter X-Forwarded-Host since it's a recognized proxy header.
